scripts.radio:
Habari za leo, mwananchi. Welcome to Kenya on Record. Let’s talk about a very disturbing matter that has been making rounds—the illegal recruitment of Kenyan youth into foreign military service, specifically targeting Russia.

Serikali kupitia Wizara ya Mambo ya Nje imethibitisha kuwa imesitisha njama hii chafu. Agents wamekuwa wakiwarubuni vijana wetu kwa ahadi za mishahara minono na kazi za ulinzi, lakini kumbe wanapelekwa mstari wa mbele vitani.

As grown-ups, we must ask: how desperate are we getting, and who is protecting our children? While unemployment is a real crisis in this country, trading your life for a rifle in a foreign war is not the way out. Our youth are our future, cannon fodder. 

The government has stepped in, yes, but vigilance begins at home. If someone approaches you or your child with suspicious job offers abroad involving private security or military training, report them immediately. Usikubali kupoteza maisha kwa sababu ya ahadi za uongo. Protect your peace, protect your life.

***

*Kwa ufupi:* Serikali imeingilia kati na kusitisha mpango haramu uliokuwa ukiwarubuni vijana wa Kenya kujiunga na jeshi la Urusi. Wazazi na vijana mnaombwa kuwa waangalifu na msiangukie kwenye mitego ya ajira za udanganyifu za nje ya nchi.
scripts.voice_note: Wadau, mambo vipi. Sikilizeni hii kwa makini sana. Kumekuwa na habari za kusikitisha za vijana wetu kurubuniwa kujiunga na jeshi la Urusi kwa ahadi za pesa nyingi. Serikali imesema imesitisha mpango huo, lakini tunafaa kuwa macho zaidi. Watu wanakuja na ahadi za uongo za kazi za ulinzi nje ya nchi, kumbe wanawapeleka vitani. Tafadhali, onya kijana wako, ndugu yako, ama rafiki yako. Usikubali maisha yako yamalizike kwa sababu ya kazi ya mkato. Angalia vizuri kabla hujakubali ofa yoyote ya nje. Tujilinde.
scripts.sms: Okoa maisha: Serikali imesitisha ulanguzi wa vijana kwenda vitani Urusi. Usikubali kurubuniwa na ahadi za uongo za kazi za 'security' nje. Linda kijana wako.
scripts.reels: Wakenya wenzangu, kuna moto chini ya moshi! Vijana wetu walikuwa wanarubuniwa kwenda kupigana vita vya Urusi kwa ahadi za pesa. Serikali imesitisha huu mchezo mchafu, lakini swali ni je—kwanini vijana wetu wanawindwa kirahisi hivi? Ukiona mtu anakuletea deal ya 'security job' nje ya nchi yenye pesa mingi kushinda akili, kimbia! Usiende ukadhani ni mchezo. Maisha yako hayana bei. Kuwa mwangalifu, linda kijana wetu, linda Kenya.
